messages:
sara: Alert from support — ACME (tkt #4241) reporting intermittent zero-length embeddings and large p99 latency on /v1/embeddings beginning right after the 10:05 deploy. They reported successful 200s where the embedding array is empty, and spikes of 500/502.

alex: can you paste an anonymized request/response sample from the customer (no auth tokens)? want to check model id + batching flags.

sara: pasted what they shared, sanitized: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
{
  "model": "text-embed-2000-q6",
  "input": ["a short sentence"],
  "batch_size": 64
}

200 OK
{
  "data": [ { "embedding": [], "dimensions": 0 } ],
  "usage": { ... }
}
```
They also saw `500` and `502` intermittently in same time window.

mike: Dashboard shows embeddings-prod-5 pool spike at 10:06--10:18: queue depth x5, p95 latency jumped 35ms -> ~1.1s, 5xx rate up to 10%.

lily: Did the 10:05 deploy change batching? I recall PR #897 touched cross-variant batching heuristics.

jordan: Yes, PR #897 enabled merging requests across model variants if output dims matched heuristically. Logs from nodes 12/13 show batch merge attempts then deserialize errors: 
```
2026-04-21T10:07:12Z batcher.go:298 info merging batch ids [b2 c3]
2026-04-21T10:07:12Z embed_deser.go:102 error dim_mismatch expected=2048 got=1536
2026-04-21T10:07:12Z httpserver.go:198 warn response written with nil embedding
```
The deserializer returned empty vectors when dims didn't match.

sara: Customer admitted they were hitting the endpoint with two client-side variants (one quantized) without pinning model id per request; their multi-item batch amplified the issue.

alex: Immediate mitigation idea: prevent merging across variants at the batcher. We can flip `batching.merge_across_variants=false` for the affected pools. That avoids mixing outputs.

mike: Ill open an incident and start a config rollout for embeddings-prod-5. @oncall-bot create incident

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0422 Embeddings batching cross-variant dim-mismatch & elevated 5xx. PagerDuty notified.

mike: Rolling change to embeddings-prod-5 now: 
```
rdctl set-config --pool embeddings-prod-5 --key batching.merge_across_variants --value false
rdctl rollout --pool embeddings-prod-5 --strategy rolling
```
Watching metrics.

lily: Also add a safe-guard in the deserializer: if output length != expected_dim then return 4xx (or a clear 422). Silent empty vectors will keep poisoning downstream. File a quick PR to change behavior in staging.

jordan: I found a correlated stacktrace with proto sizes and KV cache misses: 
```
2026-04-21T10:08:01Z batcher.go:312 debug merged payloads [1536 2048]
2026-04-21T10:08:01Z kvcache.go:121 warn missing kv-cache entry
2026-04-21T10:08:01Z embed_deser.go:88 error dim_mismatch expected=2048 got=1536
2026-04-21T10:08:01Z httpserver.go:214 error write response failed: nil embedding
```
Suggests the batcher tried to pack two requests with different expected dims.

sara: I informed the customer that our short-term mitigation is to pin model id in client requests and that were rolling config to avoid cross-variant merges. They said they can pin on their side while we fix server behavior.

alex: Long-term actions: 1) disable cross-variant merging by default unless explicit compatibility metadata present; 2) deserializer must error loudly on dim mismatch; 3) server-side validation to reject batches with mixed output dims (422).

mike: Rollout to embeddings-prod-5 finished at 10:23. 5xx rate dropped from ~10% -> 0.9% within 3 minutes, p95 back to ~40ms, queue depth normalized.

sara: Customer confirmed failures have subsided after they pinned model id. We advised updating client SDK to default to model pinning for multi-item requests.

lily: Created PR #912 to revert the aggressive merge behavior in staging and add dimensionality checks + better logging. Assigning to @eng-runtime and @eng-ml for review.

mike: Ill schedule a small canary to evaluate a safe version of cross-variant merging (if ever) with a strict compatibility matrix and server validation. Do not re-enable fleet-wide until we have tests and explicit opt-in.

sara: Drafting postmortem timeline. Root cause: PR #897 changed batching merge semantics to combine variants without strict dim checks. Symptom: empty embeddings, elevated 5xx, and slower latencies. Mitigation: flip `merge_across_variants=false` + client pin. Follow-ups: revert guard, server-side validation, SDK doc update, and more robust canarying for batching changes.

incidents-bot: incident INC-2026-0422 status -> mitigated (2026-04-21T10:28:40Z)

sara: Assigning postmortem to @lily. Will capture timeline + customer impact + follow-ups. Closing once PR merged and docs live. :thumbsup:
